- Tests counted (ordered, uncredited): 94820 Hereditary Cancer Panel 349.00; 93910 Cystic Fibrosis Carrier Screen 199.00 (both charge_reason 'ordered'; the persona's "added" belief is overridden by the record).
- Multi-test (genetic_multi_test_pricing, "Exactly two": higher full, other 50%) -> priced amount 349.00 + 99.50 = 448.50. Found via two ordered charge lines.

(c) handling_fee_amount. genetic_cancellation_fee_amount: "The genetic cancellation handling fee is the fee basis, which is the class's cancellation handling fee after accessioning … never below zero, … rounded … only at the end." Fee basis (self-pay, quote dated today) = 40 % × 313.95 = 125.58; processing stage (testing hold, consent missing) "the fee basis is multiplied by 0.6"; assistance (approved 50 % award covering today) "the fee basis is reduced by that tier's discount percentage" -> 125.58 × 0.6 × 0.5 = 37.674; extra tests (two) "10.00 is added to the handling fee"; authorization (denied + active coverage) "15.00 is subtracted from the handling fee"; appointment courtesy (one late-cancellation fee 2026-09-09, collected visits) "4.00 is subtracted from the handling fee". 37.674 + 10 − 15 − 4 = 28.674 -> **28.67**.
